turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Come, Your Majesty, let us proceed without further prevarication. State your case, and I shall endeavour to unravel the tangled threads of your predicament.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am beset on all sides by troubles, Your Lordship Holmes, and I find myself in a predicament most... delicate. My reputation, nay, the very fate of my kingdom hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I perceive that your predicament is one of a personal nature, rather than a matter of statecraft. Pray, tell me, what is the nature of this trouble that threatens your reputation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, I am intrigued by your predicament. Might I be so bold as to ask what specific action or event has led to this... delicate situation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am torn, gentlemen, between my duty to my kingdom and my obligation to my... lady. Her reputation, nay, her very person is at risk of being compromised, and I fear that my own reputation will suffer as a consequence.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that I find the mention of a lady's reputation being compromised to be a matter of considerable gravity. Might I inquire as to the nature of your relationship with this lady, and how it is that it threatens your reputation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I dare not speak her name aloud, gentlemen, lest I betray the trust that is placed in me. I must confess, I am at my wit's end, and I fear that my actions may be too late to prevent a calamity of the greatest magnitude.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal the lady's name, for it is only then that I can begin to unravel the tangled threads of this predicament.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that revealing her name would be a betrayal of the trust that she has placed in me, and I am not at liberty to compromise that trust.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I warn you, Your Majesty, that the longer you delay in revealing her name, the more precarious your situation becomes.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of my position. I am not merely concerned with the lady's reputation, but with the fate of my own kingdom, and the potential consequences of my actions.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty, I shall have to rely on my own faculties to piece together the fragments of information you have provided so far.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at a loss for what to do. My kingdom's future hangs in the balance, and I fear that every moment I delay is a moment too long.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of your situation. Can you tell us more about the circumstances that have led you to seek our assistance?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must be cautious, gentlemen, for my position is... complicated. I fear that if my true identity were to be discovered, the consequences would be... catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I find it curious, Your Majesty, that you are so concerned about your kingdom's fate, yet you seem reluctant to share the details of this... complicated situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand my position. I am caught in a web of intrigue and deception, and every word I speak may be my undoing.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that your reluctance to share more about your situation has piqued my interest. I am a medical doctor, not a diplomat or a statesman, but I have a keen sense of observation, and I am compelled to know more about the circumstances that have brought you to our doorstep.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I will not pry into the intricacies of your situation, Your Majesty, but I must insist that you provide me with some concrete details. The game, as they say, is afoot, and I will not be deterred by vague allusions to 'intrigue and deception'.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that the burden of proof may be too great for me to bear, and yet I am willing to risk everything to uncover the truth. I beg of you, do not press me for more details at this time, lest I inadvertently reveal too much.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
